edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/fs/udf/inode.c
+++ /linux/fs/udf/inode.c
@@ -2251,0 +2252,10 @@
+
+		/*
+		 * i_data is allocated based on s_blocksize - sizeof(Header).
+		 * Since we don't know the header size used for allocation (FE, EFE, USE),
+		 * we must assume the largest header (EFE) to be safe.
+		 */
+		if (alen - udf_file_entry_alloc_offset(inode) >
+		    inode->i_sb->s_blocksize - sizeof(struct extendedFileEntry))
+			alen = inode->i_sb->s_blocksize - sizeof(struct extendedFileEntry) +
+				udf_file_entry_alloc_offset(inode);

--- /linux/fs/udf/inode.c
+++ /linux/fs/udf/inode.c
@@ -2251,0 +2252,5 @@
+
+		if (ptr < iinfo->i_data ||
+		    ptr >= iinfo->i_data + inode->i_sb->s_blocksize)
+			return -1;
+
